specialist_role: Koine Greek textual translation and discourse specialist

macro_parents.function: prescript, blessing/trials/prophetic inquiry, holiness/word exhortation, growth and living-stone/people imagery
resident-alien conduct, public and household addresses, suffering example, communal virtue/apology and difficult comparison
suffering/changed-life exhortation, end-oriented gift register and fiery-trial frame
elder/younger address, humility/resistance close, doxology and epistolary greetings

textual_translation_hot_zones.issue: blessing syntax, new birth/hope/inheritance, trials, salvation wording, prophetic inquiry and Spirit-of-Christ phrase
dio inference, imperatives, citations, impartial-judge logic, ransom imagery, love, seed/word and Isaiah citation
vice-removal/growth, logikon adolon gala, living-stone catena, honor/shame and people-title citations
resident-alien imagery, conduct/visitation, human institution/creature wording, freedom and honor list
household-servant address, unjust suffering vocabulary, Christ example, passion citations and shepherd/overseer close
household participles, adornment contrast, Sarah example, weaker-vessel wording and co-heirs/prayer close
communal virtues, blessing citation, suffering conditional, fear/sanctify/apology wording and conscience
Christ-suffering/death variants, flesh/spirit datives, prison spirits, Noah, baptismal antitype and conscience/appeal/pledge
oun link, arm-yourself metaphor, suffering/cessation, vice catalogue, living/dead and gospel-to-dead wording
end frame, sober prayer, love/hospitality, gift stewardship, speech/service pair and doxology
fiery trial, glory contrast, Spirit-of-glory wording, suffering labels, judgment/citation and entrustment
elder appeal, shepherd/oversight variant, contrast list, chief-shepherd, younger submission and humility citation
humility/anxiety, adversary-lion, resistance, worldwide suffering, restoration promise and doxology
Silvanus delivery, true-grace attestation, Babylon/Mark references, kiss and peace

global_premortem.failure_mode: chapter fallback or citation/imperative atomization replaces literary movements
global_premortem.recovery: Restore the four parents and exact nested exhortation, example, citation and comparison routes.

global_premortem.failure_mode: Greek, variant, speaker or translation ambiguity becomes an authoritative boundary
global_premortem.recovery: Null the selection and retain every exact LOW alternative.

global_premortem.failure_mode: chunking authorizes doctrine, authorship, audience identity, household/political policy, baptism, afterlife, atonement, office, canon or theology
global_premortem.recovery: Reject the inference; retain candidate-only non-authorizing status.

global_guards: Greek syntax, variants, citation forms and translation options are evidence only, not authority.
No doctrine, authorship, audience identity, household/political policy, baptism, afterlife, atonement, office, canon or theology selection.
All contested routes LOW/deferred/candidate-only/non-authorizing; no forced consensus.
